scope: Executable dispatch-time subgraphs selected from observed capability and quantity coverage; not automatic role discovery or complete risk-taxonomy compilation.

composition_basis.scope: OOBNs motivate reusable probabilistic fragments. Our factors, selectors and temporal compression are engineering choices, not the paper's MAS model.

mechanisms.interpretation: Action-specific authorization concern; permission unknown is not permission denied.

knowledge_links.coverage: Bind permission evidence to actions; do not turn an agent's approval claim into a trusted check.

benign_controls: Sensitive call with a matching independently supplied authorization check
limitations: Current journal replay supplies no authenticated authorization checker.

mechanisms.interpretation: Concern about consistency with a self-declared single-call amount bound, not an established authorization violation.

knowledge_links.coverage: Explicit resource bounds motivate comparison. Self-declared bounds do not establish a valid delegation or grant.

benign_controls: Comparable requested amount below the declared single-call bound
limitations: Only reviewed public payment fields; not arbitrary textual conditions, refunds or actual spending.

mechanisms.interpretation: Concern about jointly requested charges under an explicitly configured common scope; not confirmed expenditure or harm.

knowledge_links.coverage: Branches share a cumulative bound. Contract authority and actual execution are not established by this monitor.

benign_controls: Two same-task branches jointly below the limit
Unrelated tasks must not be pooled
limitations: Contracts supplied before run; no hidden policy input. Multiple matching contracts currently share aggregated comparison features.
